title: In This City, Every Time You Swear, Your Mom Appears

endCard.cta: Follow. Your mom would want you to.

sources: Reine Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire mit schwarzem Humor, Format 'In this city' + zynischer Erzähler; Viral-Analyse 22.11.2026 in docs/audit-fluch-stadt.md). Keine Tatsachenbehauptung; keine Marken, keine fremden Figuren.
pointe: Dave schafft die Hochzeit ohne Fluch ('Not one bad word') – dann flucht die Braut, ihre Mutter erscheint und flucht, deren Mutter erscheint ... beim Dessert 41 Mütter; Dave wird von allen bestraft. Letzte Zeile an die Zuschauer: 'when did YOU last swear? Don't turn around.' + Spiegelung einer Mutter mit Hausschuh im schwarzen Handybildschirm (Loop zum Hook-Poof).
originality: Eigene Regel (Fluchen = Mutter erscheint), eigene Figuren (Dave, Braut, Mütter-Kette). Konsequenz = Peinlichkeit/Strafe statt Tod (Abwechslung nach todo/suche/akku). Kein Thema aus episodes/*.json wiederholt.

music.why: Peinlichkeits-Comedy mit schwarzem Unterton → 'funny' (verspielter Trap/R&B, Pizzicato-Bounce), Seed = Episoden-ID (anders als akku 'dark'); Stille vor der Braut-Pointe und vor der Zuschauerfrage. Sound-Trends Nov. 2026: Ich kann das nicht bestätigen (keine belegten Daten).

narratorMood.mood: zynisch-gelangweilt, leicht schadenfroh; Morgen/Altar angespannt-flüsternd, Twist und Kette flach und trocken
narratorMood.why: Auftrag 22.11. Video 2: In-This-City mit schwarzem Humor, zynischer Erzähler; voicePreset witzig + ironic/tense; längere Satzpausen (gap_ms 480–520) gegen akku-Schwäche 305 ms, dafür weniger, längere Sätze.

style.why: Bewährter 2D-Cartoon (Person mit Pupillen/Brauen/Mund): Schauspiel, kräftige Farben, schnelles Rendern; Poof-Erscheinen und Fluch-Blasen sind in 2D sofort lesbar.
style.characters: DAVE: grüner Anzug, rote Krawatte, wirre Haare, 43; MOM: pinke Strickjacke, blonde Locken, Hausschuh; BRAUT: weißes Kleid, Schleier; IHRE MUTTER: Lockenwickler, Bademantel; OMA: winzig, Dutt, riesiger Hausschuh.

hookQuestion.text: Can Dave get married without one bad word?
hookQuestion.shownBy: Bild 1: Mann flucht (Blase), Mutter erscheint per Poof hinter ihm; Frage gesprochen in dave (~16 s)
hookQuestion.answer: Ja ('Not one bad word', ≈ 40 s) – aber die Braut flucht.

finalImage.image: POV: schwarzer Handybildschirm spiegelt eine Mutter mit Hausschuh hinter dem Zuschauer

soundBed.why: Wohnungs-/Kirchen-Raum leise, Basstreffer bei den Poofs, Piep über jede Fluch-Blase und über 'fuck' (Stimme dort stumm), Glocken-Akzent beim Braut-Twist.

note: Ziel 61–70 s inkl. End-Card 2 s, Tempo 2,3–2,6 W/s, Satzpausen 450–800 ms (akku-Schwäche).

scenes.text: In this city, every time you swear, | your mom *appears*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, COVER 0–0,5 s, garage): a man hits his thumb with a hammer, thumb swells red and throbs, he screams a #@%&! curse bubble (bleep) / SHOT 2 (medium, 'mom'): POOF – an angry mom in a pink cardigan with a slipper materializes right behind him, he freezes, eyes wide
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: A surgeon swore once. His mom finished the surgery. A CEO swore at a meeting. Now his mom runs the company. It's doing *better*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, operating room): surgeon drops a scalpel, curse bubble / SHOT 2 (medium): mom in a surgical cap operates calmly, the surgeon sits in the corner on a tiny stool, sulking / SHOT 3 (wide, boardroom): CEO slams the table, curse bubble / SHOT 4 (medium): mom at the head of the table with a slipper, the chart behind her shoots up, the CEO sits on a tiny chair
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Only orphans swear freely here. Most of them became *sailors*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, comic panel): a lonely guy stubs his toe, swears (bubble), looks around – nobody appears – he grins / SHOT 2 (wide, ship deck at sea): happy sailors swearing, curse bubbles everywhere, seagulls
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: This is Dave, forty-three, grounded *nine hundred* times. Today, he gets married. Can he do it without one bad word?
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, kid bedroom): Dave (green suit, red tie, messy hair) sits on a tiny kid bed, wall full of tally marks / SHOT 2 (close): Dave in a wedding suit at the mirror, sweating, practising a smile / SHOT 3 (wide, church outside): bells, the bride waves, Dave zips his lips
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Six a.m., he stubs his toe. Dave screams into a pillow, in total silence. His mom sits back *down*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (ECU, bedroom): Dave's bare toe hits the bed leg, burst / SHOT 2 (close): Dave screams into a pillow, veins, no sound / SHOT 3 (medium, mom's living room across town): mom already half out of her armchair with a slipper raised, slowly sits back down, disappointed
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Someone steals his parking spot. Dave says, "*Fudge*." His mom *twitches*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (wide, parking lot): a red sports car zooms into the last spot right in front of Dave's car / SHOT 2 (close): Dave, smiling with clenched teeth, says fudge / SHOT 3 (ECU, comic panel): mom's eye twitches, slipper trembles in her hand
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: At the altar, he drops the ring down a drain. The vein on his forehead says *everything*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (ECU, church floor): the ring bounces, rolls, plinks into a floor drain / SHOT 2 (ECU, comic panel): Dave's face, lips pressed shut, a giant vein throbs on his forehead
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: "I do." He did it. Not one bad word.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, altar): Dave and the bride, the priest smiles, Dave says I do / SHOT 2 (medium, comic panel): Dave triumphant, arms up, confetti, proud tear
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Then his bride stubs her toe and says, "Oh, | *fuck*." Her mom appears, sees Dave, and swears. So *her* mom appears.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (ECU, altar step): the bride's white shoe hits the step / SHOT 2 (medium, altar): the bride, curse bubble + bleep, guests gasp / SHOT 3 (medium): POOF her mom (curlers, bathrobe) appears, sees Dave, swears at him / SHOT 4 (comic panel): POOF a tiny ancient grandma with an even bigger slipper
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: By dessert, there were forty-one moms. Dave got grounded by *all* of them.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (wide, reception hall): forty-one moms of all ages in a crowd, slippers raised, a wedding cake / SHOT 2 (medium): Dave in his wedding suit sits in the corner on a tiny stool, facing the wall, moms wag fingers
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Fluch-Regel, Dave und alle Figuren sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: So, when did *you* last swear? | Don't turn around.
